facts.fact: StackAdapt's Platform Quality Analyst Julia Bricknell says the platform quality team approves an average of 3,000 ads every day, according to StackAdapt's own blog.
facts.quote: Keeping this watchful eye is a busy job—on average, we approve 3,000 ads every day.

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's own blog, Julia Bricknell had audited over 80,000 ads during her first year at StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Having audited over 80,000 ads in my one year here at StackAdapt

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog states that its platform quality team conducts a human review of each campaign before it goes live, and that the review guarantees a brand safe environment for clients.
facts.quote: which is why the platform quality team conducts a meticulous human review of each campaign.
